title: Wood2 Solo #31 (목재 솔로 · cocobolo · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 ebony · 메이크업 글래스 스킨 4단계 · 아주 강함 · 배경 갤러리 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, high ponytail rose pink hair — full body orange-red cocobolo wood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING orange-red cocobolo grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID black streaks running between the carved sections, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps carved from the same cocobolo wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same cocobolo wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, heavy gold rings on every finger, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: wet-look glass skin glowing as if coated in clear gel, strong liquid highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge and the center of the forehead, a flushed rosy blush, high-shine glossy lips.

Background: a bright white-walled modern gallery hall with a polished pale floor and a full-height doorway standing open beside her, flooded with soft natural daylight from tall windows, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
